description:
• Fixed sticky hover pointer states on touch screens / WebViews (disabled Framer Motion whileHover on touch).
• Standardized bottom navigation bar sizing (width 90%, max width 448px, height 60px, radius 2rem) across Chords, Vocalex, and Hub.
• Unified sliding navigation pill transition ease and durations to match Material 3 Emphasized.
• Registered missing keyframe entry transitions (settings-content-fade-in) for settings panels.
• Scoped CSS hover rules inside media-hover blocks to prevent WebView sticky taps.
• Polished Groovex library list row/chip padding, radii, and grid margins.
